entities.name: Thomas McKee Bayne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas McKee Bayne was an officer in the Union Army during the American Civil War, a lawyer, a district attorney, and a Republican member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Pennsylvania.
